statement: At the pinned kernel revision, hid-nintendo matches Joy-Con (L) 057e:2006 and Joy-Con (R) 057e:2007 only as Bluetooth HID devices. The only USB Joy-Con entry is the Charging Grip 057e:200e, and for the grip the driver treats a failed USB handshake as fatal. A USB-bus UHID device with a single Joy-Con PID does not match the driver table.

applicability.revision: source revisions pinned in the cited source records; host versions not measured
applicability.scope: Kernel device-table and probe source only. The consequence that an unmatched USB-bus device falls to another HID driver is generic HID-core behaviour and was not run on a host. No physical Joy-Con, no host binding observed.
